answers.question: Number of CGate-calling threads
answers.answer: One owner thread/processes CGate objects for the configured session; downstream DTC/client workers do not call CGate.

answers.question: Threads and purposes
answers.answer: CGate owner polls and updates state; commands are separate armed profile only. Observer/DTC do not publish.

answers.question: conn_process cadence
answers.answer: Do not infer cadence from sleeps. Calls/sec, max gap, and idle/active/recovery callback budget: NOT_RUN.

answers.question: CGate objects used from multiple threads
answers.answer: No in the single-owner design; retain thread-owner assertions and do not share native CGate objects across workers.

answers.question: Replication stream names and initialization URLs
answers.answer: Use both inventories. Status streams are ‘Другие потоки’. Sanitize deployment endpoints.

answers.question: Open/subscription mode per stream
answers.answer: Observer opens snapshot+online. ConnectorHost mode is unknown until OPEN; TRADE may reopen from POS replstate.

answers.question: Are stream data preserved between process runs
answers.answer: Projected state is in-memory and rebuilt by snapshot after restart; archives/journals are not resumable stream replicas.

answers.question: Handled CGate messages
answers.answer: Callbacks: OPEN/CLOSE, transaction begin/commit, data, ONLINE, LIFENUM, CLEARDELETED, REPLSTATE, TIMEOUT; retain native evidence.

answers.question: Message interpretation method
answers.answer: Runtime scheme validates layouts; mapped values feed projection. Raw decoding is diagnostic; not all rows use packed structs.

answers.question: Commands sent to the trading system
answers.answer: Only AddOrder/DelOrder exist in armed TEST path. Read-only observer/DTC has no publisher/order surface; other commands are not claimed.

answers.question: Supported reply messages
answers.answer: AddOrder/DelOrder replies 179/177 differ from system replies 99/100. System replies are not ordinary success. T1 replies: NOT_RUN.

answers.question: Message allocation and destruction
answers.answer: Publisher uses cg_pub_msgnew/post/cg_pub_msgfree, then closes/destroys its handle. Read-only mode creates no publisher.

answers.question: Trading-stream heartbeats
answers.answer: TRADE heartbeat rows are consumed for stream health/time in the full profile. No claim is made for heartbeat support on unconfigured streams.

answers.question: sys_events support
answers.answer: Consume AGGR20/TRADE/PART events with generation/session/revision handling. Status sys_events are not consumed product tables.

answers.question: Index values
answers.answer: No index stream is configured or claimed.

answers.question: Market information
answers.answer: AGGR20 aggregated book: yes. COMMONS: no. Full order log: deferred; do not select options just because listed.

answers.question: Calendar-spread trading
answers.answer: No calendar-spread trading capability is claimed; decoding multi-leg records alone is not spread order support.

answers.question: Mass-operation parameters
answers.answer: No mass-order operation is exposed in the current AddOrder/DelOrder scope.

answers.question: Venue client-management commands/modes
answers.answer: No venue-side client-management command is exposed. This is distinct from downstream DTC authentication/authorization.

answers.question: Cancel on disconnect / CODHeartbeat
answers.answer: No qualified venue COD/CODHeartbeat function is claimed. Local socket disconnect cleanup or later manual Cancel is not COD.
